title: Strawberry Meringue Roulade
description: A light and airy meringue roulade filled with whipped cream and fresh strawberries.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C. Line a 25cm x 30cm lamington/biscuit pan with baking paper and lightly spray with oil to help paper stick.
Beat egg whites in a medium bowl with electric beaters until soft peaks form. Gradually beat in sugar until mixture is thick and glossy. Stir in cornflour and vinegar.
Spread meringue into pan and bake for 15 minutes. Cool completely.

Turn meringue out onto a large piece of baking paper. Spread whipped cream over meringue. Sprinkle strawberries on top. Roll meringue from the long side, using the paper to guide, into a roulade shape.
Serve roulade dusted with icing sugar.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best served immediately for maximum fluffiness. Can be made a few hours ahead, but store covered in the fridge.
